mapper.update: UPDATE ck_shop_product SET sales_count = COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(oi.quantity - COALESCE(oi.refund_quantity, 0)) FROM ck_shop_order_item oi INNER JOIN ck_shop_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.product_id = #{productId} AND o.del_flag = 0 AND o.pay_status IN ('PAID', 'PARTIAL_REFUND') AND o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'CLOSED') ), 0), month_sales_count = COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(oi.quantity - COALESCE(oi.refund_quantity, 0)) FROM ck_shop_order_item oi INNER JOIN ck_shop_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.product_id = #{productId} AND o.del_flag = 0 AND o.pay_status IN ('PAID', 'PARTIAL_REFUND') AND o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'CLOSED') AND o.pay_time >= #{monthSince} ), 0), favorite_count = COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ck_shop_favorite fa WHERE fa.product_id = #{productId} AND fa.del_flag = 0 ), 0), review_count = COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ck_shop_product_review rv WHERE rv.product_id = #{productId} AND rv.del_flag = 0 AND rv.status = 'Y' ), 0), rating_avg = COALESCE(( SELECT ROUND(AVG(rv.rating), 1) FROM ck_shop_product_review rv WHERE rv.product_id = #{productId} AND rv.del_flag = 0 AND rv.status = 'Y' ), 0) WHERE id = #{productId} AND del_flag = 0
